measured_quantities_and_default_features.visible_pe: previous visible reward prediction error / abs(risky magnitude)
measured_quantities_and_default_features.visible_regret: previous visible counterfactual minus chosen reward / abs(risky magnitude)

information_budget.observation_window: Prediction precedes each current choice. Current lottery information is available; feedback availability is given only if block instructions announce it or an earlier trial revealed it. Previous choice and observed feedback from the same block are allowed; current choice, current outcomes, future trials and response time are prohibited. Complete-feedback type is zero unless currently announced with feedback present or revealed by a strictly previous trial; when inferred from history its previous TYPE_FEEDBACK is used.
information_budget.calibration_and_history: No participant-specific fitted calibration. Online historical choices/visible outcomes are allowed identically for all models, beginning with neutral prior 0.5; history resets at every block.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
